title: Asking good technical questions
description: Turn vague bugs into reproducible technical reports with precise steps, expected and actual outcomes, and redacted diagnostic evidence.
objectives: Write exact reproduction steps and identify the failing environment
Separate observed behavior from guesses and hypotheses
Build an actionable issue containing expected and actual results
Remove obvious secrets before sharing diagnostic evidence
rubric: I recorded an exact environment, steps, expected and actual outcomes.
I distinguished confirmed observations from hypotheses.
I passed formatting, validation and basic secret-redaction tests.
